sentences.en: An ostrich cannot fly any more than a kangaroo can.
sentences.zh: 鸵鸟不能飞，就像袋鼠不能飞。

sentences.en: Elephants in Thailand are as common as kangaroos in Australia.
sentences.zh: 在泰国大象和澳大利亚的袋鼠一样常见。

sentences.en: I went to Australia, but I didn't see any kangaroos.
sentences.zh: 我去过澳大利亚，但没见到任何袋鼠。

phrases.zh: 奥地利的袋鼠（这个搭配不太自然，通常不会这么说）
